evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies core wallet accounting logic in src/wallet/rpc/transactions.cpp and src/wallet/receive.cpp.
rationale: Fixes erroneous accounting in wallet history RPCs for mixed-input transactions such as CoinJoins and Payjoins. As noted in issue #14136 (open since 2018), assuming all inputs belong to the wallet resulted in fabricated recipient sends and nonsensical or negative fees, especially after descriptor imports or rescans.
